n8n: Google Service Account Private Key Exposed in JWT Header

Severity: CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:H/UI:N/VC:L/VI:N/VA:N/SC:H/SI:L/SA:L

Aliases: CVE-2026-13676

### Am I affected? You are affected if all of the following are true: - You depend on `@better-auth/sso` at any version in `>= 1.2.10, < 1.6.11`, or any current `next` pre-release. - You enable both `sso()` and `organization()` plugins. - `providersLimit` is at its default (`10`) or any non-zero value, so SSO provider registration is enabled for authenticated users. - An organization has non-admin members, or your application can add users to organizations as regular members. You are at the highest risk if any of these also hold: - Organization membership can be obtained without a direct admin decision, such as through open invitations, self-serve onboarding, public team joins, or SCIM bulk imports. - `organizationProvisioning.defaultRole` or `organizationProvisioning.getRole` returns …
